arguments.content:
from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer
import numpy as np

model = SentenceTransformer(
    "BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5",
    revision="7999e1d3359715c523056ef9478215996d62a620"
)

with open("/app/data.txt") as f:
    docs = [line.rstrip("\n") for line in f if line.strip()]

query = "terminal-bench"

all_texts = [query] + docs
embeddings = model.encode(all_texts, normalize_embeddings=True)

query_emb = embeddings[0]
doc_embs = embeddings[1:]

similarities = doc_embs @ query_emb  # cosine sim since normalized

ranked = sorted(enumerate(similarities), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)

print("Top 10 results:")
for rank, (idx, score) in enumerate(ranked[:10], 1):
    print(f"{rank}. (score={score:.4f}) {docs[idx]}")

fifth_idx, fifth_score = ranked[4]
fifth_doc = docs[fifth_idx]
print(f"\n5th highest: {fifth_doc}")

with open("/app/result.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(fifth_doc + "\n")
